paper.title: Active Stand Testing for Identification of Orthostatic Intolerance
paper.claim: Implements a generated, descriptive heart-rate response to Brainstem's existing standing protocol without blood-pressure or clinical interpretation.
paper.population: The practical clinical method and its population do not validate a Brainstem device; this package contains generated participants only.
paper.referenceStandard: Published active-stand protocol context and deterministic participant-grouped generated R-R fixture.
paper.relationEvidence: The package independently computes a bounded heart-rate-only descriptor from Brainstem's existing timing contract; it deliberately excludes the blood-pressure measurements and clinical interpretation required by the source method.

compatibility.brainstemContract: brainstem.posture-response/generated-v1 with protected contract proposed separately
compatibility.window: Use rest [-180s,-60s) and stand [-60s,0s) relative to the end of a complete five-minute recording.
compatibility.preprocessing: Reject non-finite or implausible intervals and incomplete windows; recompute resting rate, standing p95 rate, and their difference; aggregate each participant once.
mismatches: Brainstem does not collect the continuous beat-to-beat blood pressure required by the clinical active-stand method.
The generated package does not validate sensor placement, detector error, a clinical population, or a normal range.
The canonical standing p95 is intentionally more robust than the legacy app's maximum-heart-rate score.

cohort.output: Participant-equal aggregate quartiles of descriptive standing response; no subject, recording, raw R-R, blood-pressure, or diagnostic rows.

personal.output: Owner-only median and range across up to seven eligible posture sessions, with explicit heart-rate-only limitations.
